report.summary: 6 files modified (exporters/derive.py, exporters/export_sessions.py, site/index.html and three test files). Suites: tests 358 OK (was 357 with 1 failure); page 121 passed (was 117); local/tests 304 OK. Interrupted state: export_sessions.py never passed repoPath to run_doc, so in-repo files came out as bare basenames; in the failing assertion doc['files'] was the actual value and the repo-relative list the expected one. PARSER_VERSION bumped 6 to 7 because files is a new parsed and cached row field (separate from the settled findings no-bump call). Nothing committed, staged or pushed.

changes.why: response() records write-tool input paths; agent_row carries them as files; publishable_files() resolves '..', publishes in-repo paths relative to repoPath and any other path as …/<file name>; run_doc(repo=) publishes files only when there are some.
Passes each session's project repoPath to run_doc; PARSER_VERSION 6 -> 7 so a parser-6 cache (no files) is re-parsed.

Run detail files line names the run's own edited files, explains the …/ prefix, and falls back to the files its findings name; keeps one honest limit (shell-command edits are not recorded). Location parsing cuts only a trailing line suffix, splits on ';' and ',', skips non-strings. One findingCells() helper next to md() shared by the ledger and run-detail rows.
Pins the outside-repo decision and the '..' climb-out cases.
End-to-end repo-relative files; a cache signed by parser 6 is not reused; hasFindingsBlock and pbis stay off the run document.
Edited-files line, location parsing, NFR-22 guard, single finding-cells source.

tests.covers: test_a_run_document_names_a_file_edited_outside_the_repository_without_its_folder; test_a_cache_from_before_edited_files_were_parsed_is_not_reused (signs parser 6, so it fails without the bump)

'AC-82: a picked run names the files it edited'; 'run detail: file names are read from a finding location...' (CR-014-5); 'NFR-22: the run detail uses status tiles...'
